heading: Terms of Use
body:

Information, not professional advice

Articles are provided for general information and education. They are not legal, financial, medical or professional advice. Before acting on anything you read here, confirm the details that matter to your situation with a qualified professional and with the primary source.

Accuracy and change

We work to keep articles accurate and we update them when we learn something is wrong. Software, prices, policies and regulations change, so an article reflects what was true when it was reviewed. Check the published and updated dates on every article.

We link to other websites for sources and further reading. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content, terms or privacy practices.

The text, layout and original graphics on this site belong to their respective owners. You may quote short extracts with clear attribution and a link to the original article. Republishing whole articles requires written permission.

Acceptable use

Do not attempt to disrupt the site, scrape it at a rate that degrades service, probe it for vulnerabilities without permission, or use it to distribute unlawful material.

Limitation of liability

The site is provided on an "as is" basis. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the site or reliance on its content.

Configuration required before launch

Add the governing law and jurisdiction, and the operator's legal name, before commercial launch.
